describe.description: The creature is a single chimeric animal standing in right-facing profile on a small patch of bare ground with sparse tufts of grass. Its body is that of a large, muscular lion, covered in short tawny-brown fur with a lighter cream belly and inner legs, supported by four sturdy legs and ending in a long tail. Its head, neck, chest and wings are those of an eagle, covered in layered brown, golden-brown, cream and dark brown feathers, with a hooked beak and a sharp eye. Two large feathered wings are spread upward and outward from its upper back. The overall coloration is warm browns and golds with darker flight feathers and a dark tail tuft.

describe.description: A large four-legged creature standing in side view facing right, with the head, hooked beak, feathered neck and chest, and large spread wings of a brown eagle merging into the muscular tawny body, legs, paws and tufted tail of a lion. The two broad wings are raised up and out behind the shoulders, the chest feathering is shaggy brown and cream, and the lion-like hindquarters stand on four paws on a small patch of bare ground with sparse grass.
